en.html:
I went to the chamber where Shirou Kuniuji Ashikaga was waiting, understanding almost nothing of why.

On the way I had tried asking the lady who led me. She gave me one curt answer, "Don't know," and after that, nothing.

Whether she truly didn't know, who could say? Pressing her was not possible, so I closed my mouth and walked.

An inner room, at the back. At her signal I stepped in. The lady did not follow. Behind me she shut the sliding door with a bang that had opinions.

en.html:
True, if ceremony was to be strictly followed, a court noble would not be having a conversation with a petty public officer like me in the first place.

...Still, what was this sudden favour? Perhaps the boy had become very fond of me after the other day's business. But calling me into an inner chamber for football discussion, surely not.

He had dispensed with my greeting. Very good. But his own business was not beginning either. Only silence, looking here and there for a word.

With his position and my position, I could hardly say, chalo, come to the point. So. What to do?

Was I being expected to open some sixth sense now? Mine had not yet opened. The first five were present and doing their best, but His Highness appeared to require the next model.

A person is like... like... I think. Very good. Shall I understand the first 'like,' or the second? Perhaps the meaning was in the interval. Unfortunately I had spent that interval waiting for the sentence. My mistake. Next time I would listen more carefully to the part he did not say.

Asking the defeated for peace is not such an easy matter for the victor. Perhaps harder than asking from the defeated side.

Shirou Kuniuji could not seem to finish a thought. But a person with decent feelings might well have this difficulty. I nodded, to give him a little help.

en.html:
Kageaki"What Your Highness wishes to send Princess Sakurako is not merely an object, I believe."
Kuniuji"...?"
Kageaki"The gift is the means. What you wish to reach her is your concern for her, is it not?"
Kuniuji"Y-yes."
Kageaki"Then the object may be anything. Enough that Your Highness's feeling can travel with it."
Kageaki"If a particular thing she wants were known to us, that would be another matter. At present only she knows. So this one consideration is enough. Please choose what your heart tells you."
Kuniuji"...But what if she thinks, what useless thing has he sent me...?"
Kageaki"I do not think Your Highness need fear that. An ordinary fool like myself is hardly qualified to measure a noble person's character."
Kageaki"Still, from that princess I would surely expect this much... With the gift, your kindness also will be received."
Kuniuji"...I see..."
Kuniuji"Haan, you are right! Thank you, Arata. Now the confusion has cleared."
Kageaki"Yes, Your Highness."
